probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Nordhavn Overview Buy Ella Mae Pilot Crew Ferry Models Pilot Crew Ferry Company About Team Investors Careers Media News Events Owners Service Charging Customer stories Contact Nordhavn Pilot cleared for service on the Maas The Dutch flag authority has approved the Pilot for year round work on the Nieuwe Maas and the port approaches. The first four boats join the Rotterdam pilot station in November. Published 21 September 2026 Category Approvals Press contact [email protected] LinkedIn Copy link The Pilot has passed its last sea trials and received approval from the Dutch flag authority for year round service on the Nieuwe Maas, the Calandkanaal and the approaches to the port of Rotterdam. The approval covers both lengths, the P12 and the P15, in the pilot station layout. It follows six weeks of trials in which two boats ran full twelve hour shifts alongside the station’s diesel launches, coming alongside inbound ships at up to 18 knots. What happens next The first four boats join the Rotterdam pilot station in November. Each one replaces a diesel launch and charges at a new quay mast at the station between jobs, with a full shift on one charge in normal conditions.
